text:
tyler: FYI - ACME reported a streaming /chat SSE cut off mid-event. They get a partial JSON event, then connection reset from the client. No 5xx on our side. stacktrace + example attached in ticket 8765.

sam: Customer says it happened after ~90s of idle, they tried reconnecting and got duplicate partial responses. Very noisy on retries; billing spike.

alex: Can you paste the raw event they got (headers + last chunk)? Also any proxy logs (ALB/Cloudflare) + x-request-id if available.

tyler: Pasted from customer:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK\ncontent-type: text/event-stream\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\nconnection: keep-alive\n\n7\n{"id":1,"partial":true}\n0\n\n```
They see that JSON then the socket closes. No trailing \n

alex: Hmm that chunked framing looks normal. Do we see a FIN from upstream? Any ALB logs showing a 504 or 502?

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: nginx-proxy change (proxy_buffering=on, proxy_read_timeout=90s) by maria at 1716501200.

maria: That deploy turned on buffering for the legacy CDN origin pool (to reduce small-object M/T). IIRC proxy_read_timeout default was 60s and I set 90s intentionally.

alex: If nginx starts buffering, it will buffer until the upstream completes or buffer fills, then flush as a big chunk. For SSE we must have `proxy_buffering off`. Buffering + ALB idle timeout mismatch can cause half-close. Could be ALB idle at 60s while proxy_read_timeout at 90s — ALB kills the client side first.

tyler: ALB idle timeout for this customer’s region: 60s (ELB default). Customer observed ~75-95s behavior, so that matches a timeout interplay.

sam: Customer also sits behind Cloudflare in front of ALB. Cloudflare has its own edge idle window (typically 100s) and chunked encoding quirks.

alex: Repro plan: 1) spin up a tiny SSE server that emits a tiny event every 10s, 2) route through our nginx-proxy with `proxy_buffering on` and `proxy_read_timeout=90`, 3) hit through ALB with default idle 60s and observe.

maria: Can reproduce locally w/ this curl: 
```
# hit through ALB/nginx chain
curl -v -N https://my-alb.example.com/stream?test=chunk-interleave
```
When proxy_buffering is on we see data accumulate and then a reset around ALB idle threshold.

alex: Also try raw TCP to origin to confirm server isn't closing: `openssl s_client -quiet -connect origin:443` then send minimal HTTP and watch stream. If origin keeps sending but client side closed -> proxy/ALB.

tyler: Customer also reported auth errors right after reconnects (401). Could be token rotation happening during reconnect flood. Billing break: they got charged for each reconnect message.

sam: Important: add mitigation steps for customer.

maria: Short-term mitigation for customers: set ALB idle timeout >= proxy_read_timeout (recommend 300s for long SSE sessions) OR set `proxy_buffering off` for SSE endpoints in nginx. Also enforce reconnect backoff client-side.

alex: Suggested config diff to roll back quickly:
```
# in nginx location /stream
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_send_timeout 360s;
proxy_read_timeout 360s;
# ensure proxy_http_version 1.1 and Connection: keep-alive
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
```
Note: `proxy_set_header Connection ""` avoids adding `Connection: close` inadvertently.

tyler: I applied `proxy_buffering off` and bumped timeouts in staging proxy. Reproduced the curl test, stream stayed open across 5+ minutes with periodic 10s events.

ops-bot: Alert muted for ACME ticket 8765 during investigation.

maria: Rollback plan: revert the global `proxy_buffering on` change for the legacy pool, or scope it to non-streaming locations only. Will open a PR to scope this by route.

alex: Also add ALB config guidance in our support KB: doc snippet recommending ALB idle >= 2x heartbeat interval, and disable chunk coalescing on any CDN layer. For Cloudflare specifically: confirm `origin_keepalive_timeout` and disable `http2` edge optimizations that coalesce small chunks.

sam: For billing: reduce duplicate-recorded tokens for reconnects by marking retries within Xs as duplicates at billing layer. File a follow-up.

tyler: Follow-ups for support ticket:
- Confirm customer can accept a brief maintenance window to apply fix.
- Share curl repro + instruct them to set `Connection: keep-alive` and backoff.
- Reduce immediate billing impact (manual credit if large).

alex: I'll add tracing hooks to the SSE path to log `X-Forwarded-For`, `x-request-id`, `upstream_response_time` and final chunk sizes so we can triage faster next time.

maria: PR: revert buffering globally -> add `location /stream { proxy_buffering off; }` targeting streams, test in canary, then promote. ETA 2h.

tyler: Customer confirmed test after we applied scoped change: they no longer see partial JSON then close. They saw one reconnect attempt which succeeded with full event.

sam: Closing loop: schedule KB update and billing follow-up ticket 9982.

tyler: Thanks everyone :heart: marking thread resolved for now.
